specifications.statement: Document says system ships with eight fan trays; hot-swappable without powering switch off. Do not leave an empty fan-tray slot; replace failed trays as soon as possible. Shipping specification, not installed-unit count. [PDF p. 3]

4RU chassis requires separately ordered L-shaped rack-rails in a 19-inch rack; screw-type/tool-less rail methods and adapters for 29-inch-deep racks are described. No rail order code is supplied. [PDF p. 1]

Document warns to use provided accessories/screws; top of enclosure is a hot surface; install in a restricted-access location. These are published restrictions, not a fresh endorsement of safe standalone use. [PDF p. 1]
Operating0 to45 C, storage-40 to70 C; operating humidity5% to85% non-condensing. Operating altitude up to1829 m (6000 ft) at0 to35 C, not entire0 to45 C range. [PDF p. 4]
Use four lifting handles, secure chassis with four #12-24-16L screws; install air baffles between chassis units and secure baffle to front of rack-rails with two M4 screws. [PDF p. 2]
W x D x H 440.4 x 755.5 x 176.2 mm (17.34 x 29.74 x 6.94 in), 4RU. 55 kg (121.25 lb) specifically with one SCM, eight PIMs, eight fan trays and four PSUs; not bare-chassis weight. [PDF p. 4]

100–120 VAC,50/60Hz,10A per PS x4;200–240 VAC,50/60Hz,7A per PS x4;200–277 VAC,50/60Hz,9A per PS x4, with explicit exception for Bel Fuse and Murata power supply. Preserve all three conditioned lines; no universal277V fitment or sum of currents implied. [PDF p. 4]
3000 Watts maximum power consumption is printed for switch chassis; not PSU output or measured draw of an auction unit. [PDF p. 4]
Connect PSU AC sockets to at least two separate AC power circuits for redundancy; use retention clips for power cords. No per-PSU manufacturer/model or rated output supplied here. [PDF p. 2]

Up to four universal AC PSUs; source says whole chassis can operate with two installed PSUs and three or four provide redundancy. Published system statement, not bootability/configuration of an empty chassis, SCM or auction unit. [PDF p. 2]

With four-PSU system and a failed PSU, source says operation continues with three PSUs installed; replace PSU within 10 minutes. Keep this service limit separate from general two-PSU operation statement. [PDF p. 3]
